# Spec: Check the running service

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/check-the-running-service.md)

**Start:** `/operations/info`  
**Persona:** An operator  
**Goal:** See which environment the API runs in and find a configuration setting.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Read the runtime facts | The environment is shown. |
| 2 | Find a setting | Only matching settings remain. |
